prosody_instruction: Speak confidently and steadily, with clear declarative tone. Decisive pacing, even rhythm, no filler words.

chunks.text: I keep thinking about how packed my Xi'an days are going to be—I'm basically lining up a bunch of attractions there back-to-back.
And after that leg, I’m heading to Wuhan and planning to sort out a hotel base there so I’m not bouncing around every night.
For Xi’an, I’ve already got the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda on the calendar for 2026-05-12, and I’m putting it under Xie Peng.
That Pagoda visit is set for the afternoon, and it’s a group thing—ticket count is 5, so it’s going to be a bit of a herd.

Then in Wuhan I’m staying at Wanda Realm Wuhan, checking in 2026-05-24 for 2 nights, and the hotel name is under Hu Bin—after that I’ll probably just wander around and see how I feel about the next stop...
